blocks.html:
Custom Screen Printing for Westminster's Tech & College Community

Westminster spans Adams and Jefferson counties with about 115,000 residents and a notable mix of technology companies, healthcare employers, and Front Range Community College — the largest community college in Colorado, with its main campus here in Westminster. Trimble Inc., a global technology company with 11,500 employees worldwide, is headquartered in Westminster. Custom corporate apparel for team events, product launches, and company outings is a regular need in this kind of professional environment.

Front Range Community College's Westminster campus serves nearly 22,000 students and generates demand for custom apparel — from the college's Wolves athletics to student clubs and campus events. Westminster's K-12 population splits between Adams 12 Five Star Schools and Jefferson County School District, with Legacy High School Lightning and Westminster High School Wolves among the competitive athletic programs that regularly need spirit wear and team uniforms.
